description: SlimPark electric vehicle charging data 2022-2023 is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Gerwin Hoogsteen. The data in this dataset was collected at the SlimPark living lab for smart electric vehicle (EV) charging and energy management at the University of Twente. This living lab consists of EV chargers, an array of solar panels, and a battery energy storage system. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
